entities.summary: Vostochny Port is an intermodal container port at the eastern end of the Trans-Siberian Railway. It is the largest port in the Russian Far East. It is located in Vrangel, Primorsky Krai. A deepwater port on Nakhodka Bay, it operates year-round and is suitable for handling large tonnage ships. Vostochny is a warm-water port in the Russian Far East.
